caption: An active system message, as every user sees it
preconditions: The three seeded system messages exist (seed.py, SYSTEM_MESSAGES) and 'Planned maintenance tonight' is the only active one: run `python3 seed.py --api-url http://localhost:5011/api --system-message-on` before this page's shots and `python3 seed.py --api-url http://localhost:5011/api` right after, because an active message is a toast on every page of every other shot
steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring and wait for [data-test-id="workspace-navigation"] to be visible
wait until [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] contains at least one [data-test-id="article-item"]
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: Messages are rendered by SystemMessagesComponent (scripts/apps/system-messages/components/system-messages.tsx, mounted in scripts/core/menu/views/superdesk-view.html) as superdesk-ui-framework toasts at position 'top', class sd-toast sd-toast--<type>. They have no duration, so they stay until closed. The message must be active before the page loads, or be created while the page is open (websocket resource:created triggers a re-render). Any logged-in user sees it; admin is used only because the journalist test user has no monitoring access. The message text must stay under 200 characters including HTML (server maxlength).

caption: Creating a system message
preconditions: Logged in user has the system_messages privilege (admin has all)
steps: Open #/settings/system-messages and wait for [data-test-id="list-page--add-item"] to be visible

steps.value: Superdesk will be unavailable from 22:00 to 22:30 for an upgrade. Save your work before then.

notes: Form config is in scripts/apps/system-messages/components/system-messages-settings.tsx: Active (checkbox), Style (select: Info, Success, Warning, Alert; the select has data-test-id gform-input--type), Title (plain text, gform-input--message_title), Message (Editor3 with bold, italic, underline and link). The side panel heading is 'Details' and the toolbar shows Cancel and Save. Do not save: the shot shows the filled, unsaved form. The Active checkbox is a styled checkbox; if clicking the label does not tick it, click its input with force. The Style select may default to empty, which is fine to replace.

caption: The list of system messages
preconditions: The three seeded system messages exist (seed.py, SYSTEM_MESSAGES), all inactive: capture this shot with the plain seed (no --system-message-on), otherwise the active message's toast covers the list. The list shows no active/inactive marker, so nothing is lost.
steps: Open #/settings/system-messages and wait for [data-test-id="list-page--items"] to be visible
notes: The active warning message also shows as a toast at the top of this page; that is fine and shows the result, or close it before the shot with the toast's close button (button.sd-toast__actions). The list is sorted by title, ascending. Each row shows the title, the message as plain text and a coloured style label (Info, Success, Warning, Alert); Edit (pencil) and Remove (bin) icons appear in the row's action area. The list page uses data-test-ids from the generic list page (scripts/core/ui/components/ListPage/generic-list-page.tsx).
